name: Makan Family Scholarship
summary: Up to $30,000 for First Peoples or historically marginalised students in the Bachelor of Musical Theatre.
key: Maximum value of each scholarship is up to $30,000, payable in instalments.
who: Commencing or continuing full-time in the Bachelor of Musical Theatre.
Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, or from a historically marginalised group.
Australian citizen, permanent resident, permanent humanitarian visa holder or New Zealand citizen.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Listed as coming soon for 2027; the 2026 round closed 30 March 2026.
